code:
# Fast Gradient Sign Method (conceptual)
# loss  = model's loss for the input's TRUE label
# input = an image the model already classifies correctly

gradient = d(loss) / d(input)
perturbation = epsilon * sign(gradient)
adversarial_input = input + perturbation

# epsilon caps the size of the change (an L-infinity budget)
# -> imperceptible to a human, but enough to cross the boundary
caption: A white-box attacker nudges every input dimension toward higher loss, bounded by epsilon.
